settings.headroomProxyUrlHint: Ana iya fara Loopback URLs daga wannan shafin. External URLs kuwa bincikawa kawai ake yi.
settings.headroomProxyExternalHint: Wannan URL ɗin ba loopback ba ne, don haka OmniRoute ba zai ƙaddamar da local CLI ba.
settings.cliproxyapiImportAuthDesc: Shigo da asusun OAuth da CLIProxyAPI ya riga ya adana a ~/.cli-proxy-api/ a matsayin haɗin OmniRoute, don kada ka sake shiga kowane asusu. Za a shigo da nau’ikan asusun da ake tallafawa (Gemini, Codex, Claude, Antigravity, Qwen, Kimi); sauran kuwa za a tsallake su.
settings.payloadRulesDesc: Saita sauye-sauyen payload na buƙata bisa model da protocol. Ana adana sauye-sauyen a cikin saituna kuma a sake loda su kai tsaye a runtime nan da nan bayan an adana.
settings.payloadRuleDefaultDesc: Yana amfani da params ne kawai idan babu target path a cikin payload mai fita.
settings.payloadRuleOverrideDesc: Yana tilasta sanya ƙimomi a cikin payload, tare da maye gurbin duk wani abu da yake akwai a wannan path.
settings.payloadRuleFilterDesc: Yana cire params da aka katange daga payload kafin a aika buƙatar upstream.
settings.payloadRuleDefaultRawDesc: Kamar default, amma ana fara fassara ƙimomin string a matsayin JSON idan zai yiwu. Ana kuma karɓar tsohon input alias default-raw yayin adanawa.
settings.payloadEditorDesc: Yi amfani da tsarin runtime schema: default, override, filter, defaultRaw. API kuma yana karɓar tsohon input key default-raw.
settings.payloadResetInfo: An mayar da edita zuwa samfuri tsaka-tsaki. Adana don aiwatar da shi.
settings.payloadSaveSuccess: An adana ka’idojin payload kuma an sake loda su kai tsaye.
settings.payloadMustBeObject: Dole ne ka’idojin payload su kasance JSON object.
settings.payloadValidJsonRequired: Dole ne ka’idojin payload su kasance ingantaccen JSON kafin adanawa.
settings.requestLimitsDesc: Saita iyakokin buƙata na gaba ɗaya da matakan kariyar concurrency.
settings.maxRequestSizeDesc: Matsakaicin girman da aka yarda da shi ga buƙatun API masu shigowa.
settings.maxResponseSizeDesc: Matsakaicin girman da aka yarda da shi ga amsoshin API masu fita.
settings.maxRequestTokensDesc: Matsakaicin jimillar tokens da aka yarda da su a cikin buƙata guda.
settings.maxResponseTokensDesc: Mafi yawan jimillar tokens da aka yarda da su a cikin amsa guda.
settings.modelCooldownsTitle: Models da ke cikin lokacin jira
settings.modelCooldownsEmpty: Babu models da ke cikin lokacin jira a yanzu.
settings.modelCooldownsDescription: Models da aka ware na ɗan lokaci bayan gazawa. Idan lokacin jiran ya ƙare, za su dawo ta atomatik.
settings.modelCooldownsAllReactivated: An sake kunna duk models da ke cikin lokacin jira.
settings.responsesStateDesc: Sarrafa yadda OmniRoute ke tura previous_response_id.
settings.responsesStateHint: Yanayin Auto yana cire previous_response_id sai dai idan wani haɗi ya kunna ma'ajiyar OpenAI Responses a sarari. Strip ne mafi aminci ga abokan ciniki marasa adana yanayi kamar VS Code Custom Endpoint; daga nan mahallin zai dogara da abokin ciniki ya aika cikakken tarihi.
settings.responsesStateSaveError: An kasa sabunta saitin yanayin Responses
settings.codexFastTierDesc: Saka service_tier=priority ga duk buƙatun OpenAI Codex a duniya.
settings.codexFastTierHint: Idan an kunna, OmniRoute yana ƙara service_tier=priority ga buƙatun Codex masu fita daga haɗe-haɗen da ba su riga sun ƙayyade mataki ba. Matakin Priority yana buƙatar maɓallin OpenAI Enterprise API ko hanyar Codex ta ChatGPT-auth; sauran nau'ikan maɓalli za su karɓi kuskure mai alaƙa da mataki daga OpenAI. Saitunan kowace haɗi a shafin mai samar da Codex su ne ke da fifiko.
settings.codexFastTierSaveError: An kasa sabunta saitin Codex Fast Tier
settings.codexAutoPingDesc: Zaɓin shiga ne ga kowace haɗi: yana aika ƙaramar buƙata nan da nan bayan taga zaman Codex ta sake farawa, don kada ya kasance bai shirya ba lokacin da kake buƙatarsa.
settings.codexAutoPingWarning: Yana cin ɗan ƙaramin kaso na ainihin ƙimar Codex a kowane ping. A kashe yake ta tsohuwa — kunna shi kawai ga haɗin da kake dogaro da su sosai.
settings.codexAutoPingSaveError: An kasa sabunta saitin Codex Auto-Ping
settings.codexAutoPingToggleAria: Kunna ko kashe auto-ping na ƙimar Codex ga {connection}
settings.codexFastTierModelsHint: Samfuran da aka zaɓa kawai ne za su karɓi service_tier idan an kunna Fast Tier.
settings.claudeFastModeDesc: Sanya zaɓaɓɓun buƙatun Claude cikin Anthropic Fast Mode (speed:"fast").
settings.claudeFastModeHint: Anthropic ba ya goyon bayan Fast Mode a hukumance ga abokan ciniki irin na SDK. Idan an kunna, OmniRoute yana tura taken X-CPA-Force-Fast-Mode domin ginin CLIProxyAPI da aka haɗa ya iya zaɓar shiga ta hanyar kwaikwayon mashigar. Samfuran Opus da aka jera kawai ne binciken gefen abokin ciniki na Anthropic ke taƙaitawa. Har yanzu ana aiwatar da matakin biyan kuɗi, shirin Max, da ragowar ƙimar Fast Mode a gefen sabar — Anthropic na iya mayar da out_of_credits ko da an kunna maɓallin.
settings.claudeFastModeModelsLabel: An yi amfani da shi ga samfura ({count})
settings.claudeFastModeSaveError: An kasa sabunta saitin Claude Fast Mode

wildcard.title: CORS a buɗe yake ga kowace tushe (CORS_ALLOW_ALL=true)
wildcard.desc: Kowane gidan yanar gizo zai iya kiran API na wannan sabar daga burauzar baƙo. Yi amfani da shi kawai a cibiyoyin sadarwa masu aminci — saita takamaiman tushe a ALLOWED_ORIGINS kuma ka kashe CORS_ALLOW_ALL a yanayin samarwa.

authz.title: Jerin Izini
authz.description: Rarraba hanya mai matakai 5 tare da manufar kaucewa kai tsaye. Karantawa yana nuna cikakken tsarin rarrabawa; gyare-gyare suna sake neman kalmar sirrin gudanarwa.

kill_switch.label: Kill-switch na tsallakewa
kill_switch.desc: Babban maɓalli. Idan a kashe yake, ba za a iya isa ga kowane prefix na LOCAL_ONLY daga wajen loopback ba, ko da menene jerin prefix ɗin da aka saita.

prefix.label: Prefix ɗin da za a iya tsallakewa
prefix.desc: Prefix na LOCAL_ONLY waɗanda maɓallan API masu manage-scope (ko zaman dashboard) za su iya isa gare su daga na'urorin da ba na loopback ba.
prefix.empty: Ba a saita wani prefix ba. A zahiri, an kashe tsallakewar.

bypass.cli_tools_runtime_note: Prefix mai iya ƙaddamar da tsari. An hana shi a lokacin compile; ba za a iya sa ya zama abin tsallakewa ba. Ana nuna shi a matsayin na karantawa kawai.

prompt.label: Kalmar sirri ta yanzu
prompt.desc: Sake tabbatarwa don aiwatar da sauye-sauyen da suka shafi tsaro.

authz.pending: Sauye-sauyen da ba a ajiye ba

badge.bypassable: Za a iya tsallakewa ta manage scope

error.PASSWORD_REQUIRED: Ana buƙatar kalmar sirri ta yanzu don aiwatar da waɗannan sauye-sauye.
error.PASSWORD_MISMATCH: Kalmar sirri ta yanzu ba daidai ba ce.
error.INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE: Maɓallin API ba shi da manage scope.
error.BYPASS_PREFIX_NOT_ALLOWED: Prefix ɗaya ko fiye suna nufin hanyoyi masu iya ƙaddamar da tsari kuma ba za a iya tsallake su ba.

settings.resilienceRequestQueueEffect: Yana jera buƙatu, yana iyakance adadin ayyukan da ke gudana lokaci guda, kuma yana ba da tazara tsakanin kiraye-kiraye
settings.resilienceRequestQueueDesc: Wannan matakin yana sarrafa jerin gwano da daidaita sauri ne kawai. Ba ya adana lokutan cooldown ko kunna circuit breakers.
settings.resilienceAutoEnableApiKeyProvidersDesc: Yana kunna kariyar jerin gwano ta tsohuwa ga haɗin API key masu aiki.
settings.resilienceConnectionCooldownTrigger: Lokacin da haɗi ya bayar da gazawar wucin gadi daga upstream
settings.resilienceConnectionCooldownEffect: Yana tsallake wannan haɗin na ɗan lokaci kuma yana ƙara backoff idan gazawa ta maimaitu
settings.resilienceConnectionCooldownDesc: Asalin cooldown yana ɗaukar gazawar haɗi ta wucin gadi. Idan an kunna alamomin sake gwadawa na upstream, takamaiman lokacin da mai samarwa ya bayar zai maye gurbin cooldown na gida.
settings.resilienceUseUpstreamRetryHintsDesc: Yana amfani da ƙimomin retry-after/reset daga mai samar da upstream idan suna nan.
settings.resilienceUseUpstream429BreakerHints: Yi amfani da alamomin upstream 429 don cooldown na breaker
settings.resilienceUseUpstream429BreakerHintsDesc: Aiwatar da siginonin Retry-After / quota-exhausted daga martanin 429 wajen ƙayyade tsawon cooldown na circuit-breaker. Tsoho yana amfani da manufofin kowane mai samarwa: masu samar da cloud kai tsaye suna kunne ta tsohuwa; masu samar da reverse-proxy, self-hosted, da CLI-backed suna kashe ta tsohuwa. Wannan bai dogara da "Yi amfani da alamomin sake gwadawa na upstream" ba.
settings.resilienceProviderBreakerTrigger: Gazawar transport/server ta ƙarshe bayan duk hanyoyin fallback na haɗi sun ƙare
settings.resilienceProviderBreakerEffect: Yana toshe wannan mai samarwa na ɗan lokaci har sai lokacin reset ya ƙare
settings.resilienceProviderBreakerDesc: Yanayin breaker na kai-tsaye yana bayyana ne kawai a shafin Health. Iyakokin rate limit na 429 da suka shafi haɗi suna ci gaba da kasancewa a Connection Cooldown kuma ba sa kunna breaker na mai samarwa.
settings.resilienceWaitForCooldownTrigger: Lokacin da duk haɗin da za a iya amfani da su suke cikin cooldown
settings.resilienceWaitForCooldownEffect: Yana jira a kan server sannan ya sake gwadawa idan cooldown na farko ya ƙare
settings.resilienceWaitForCooldownDesc: Wannan yana shafar buƙatar yanzu ne kawai. Ba ya adana yanayin haɗi ko na mai samarwa.
settings.resilienceEnableServerWaitDesc: Idan an kunna, OmniRoute yana jira cooldown na farko ya ƙare sannan ya sake gwadawa ta atomatik.
settings.resilienceMaxWaitPerAttempt: Matsakaicin lokacin jira ga kowane yunƙuri
settings.resilienceComboCooldownWaitDesc: Ga duk dabarun combo: jira ɗan gajeren cooldown na wucin gadi sannan a sake tura buƙatar maimakon mayar da 429 nan take. Ba ya taɓa jira kan quota_exhausted.
settings.resilienceComboCooldownWaitToggleDesc: Duk dabarun combo; ba ya taɓa jira kan quota_exhausted.
settings.resilienceComboCooldownMaxWaitMs: Matsakaicin lokacin jira ga kowane yunƙuri
settings.resilienceQuotaShareConcurrencyTitle: Concurrency na kowane haɗi na quota-share
settings.resilienceQuotaShareConcurrencyDesc: Ga combo na quota-share kawai: idan haɗi ya saita iyakar Max Concurrent, a jera buƙatun da ke gudana lokaci guda zuwa wannan asusun rajista domin kada a taɓa cika shi fiye da iyakarsa. Ƙarin buƙatu za su jira a jerin gwano maimakon samun 429. Iyakancewar tana fitowa ne daga filin Max Concurrent na kowane haɗi; wannan maɓallin yana kunna ko kashe bin wannan iyaka ne kawai.
settings.resilienceQuotaShareConcurrencyToggleDes: Combo na quota-share kawai; yana bin iyakar Max Concurrent ta kowane haɗi.
settings.resilienceProviderCooldownTrigger: Lokacin da mai samarwa/haɗi ya gaza
settings.resilienceProviderCooldownEffect: Yana tsallake mai samarwar da ya gaza na tsawon lokacin cooldown kafin sake gwadawa
settings.resilienceProviderCooldownDesc: Yana hana buƙatu na gaba sake bi ta cikin masu samarwa iri ɗaya da ke gazawa. Cooldown yana ƙaruwa ninki-ninki bisa yawan gazawar da suka biyo juna.
settings.resilienceProviderCooldownEnabled: Kunna lokacin dakatar da mai samarwa na gama-gari
settings.resilienceProviderCooldownEnabledDesc: Idan an kunna, ana bibiyar masu samarwa da suka gaza a ko'ina kuma a tsallake su na wani lokacin dakatarwa.
settings.resilienceCredentialHealthScope: Duk haɗin API-key da OAuth masu aiki
settings.resilienceCredentialHealthEffect: Yana gwada bayanan shaidar kowane haɗi kuma ya sanya masa alamar yana aiki/kuskure; haɗe-haɗen da suka gaza suna ƙara jinkirin sake gwadawa ninki-ninki
settings.resilienceCredentialHealthDesc: Binciken bayan-fage da ke tabbatar da bayanan shaidar kowane haɗi mai aiki ta hanyar kiran mai samarwarsa. Saita 0 don kashe binciken gaba ɗaya. Ƙimomin Duba Lafiya na kowane haɗi (a akwatin gyaran kowane haɗi) koyaushe suna rinjayar wannan tsohon saitin gama-gari.
settings.resilienceCredentialHealthHint: 0 yana kashe binciken bayan-fage (mafi yawa minti 1440 = awa 24). Haɗin da ke da nasu ƙimar Duba Lafiya suna yin watsi da wannan tsohon saitin gama-gari; saita 0 ga wani haɗi yana cire wannan haɗin daga binciken ko da binciken gama-gari yana kunne.
settings.forcedFingerprintTitle: Kullum a kunne don {provider} — wajibi ne don tsaron asusun OAuth; ba za a iya kashe shi ba.
settings.sessionAffinityDesc: Yana riƙe tattaunawa ɗaya a kan asusu ɗaya na tsawon wannan adadin daƙiƙu, ga kowane mai samarwa. 0 yana kashe shi.
settings.resetAwareQuotaCacheTitle: Ma'ajiyar keɓe mai lura da sake saiti
settings.resetAwareQuotaCacheDesc: Yana adana bayanan sa ido na keɓe don jerantawa mai lura da sake saiti kawai. Binciken farko na keɓe har yanzu yana kare buƙatu. 0/0 yana ci gaba da ɗauko bayanai kai tsaye.
settings.qdrantCleanupSuccess: Ya yi: an cire maki {count} (lokacin riƙewa: kwanaki {days})
settings.vercelRelaySuccess: An tura Vercel Relay cikin nasara
settings.vercelRelayWarning: Gargaɗi: Ana buƙatar token na turawa na Vercel. Za a yi amfani da wannan token ne kawai don ƙirƙirar relay marar sabar kuma OmniRoute ba zai taɓa adana shi ba.
settings.vercelRelayFreeTierNote: Relays ƙananan wuraren ƙarshen proxy ne da ake turawa a matakin kyauta na Vercel don kauce wa iyakokin cibiyar sadarwa/yanki na gida.
settings.denoRelayWarning: Gargaɗi: Ana buƙatar token na ƙungiyar Deno Deploy. Za a yi amfani da wannan token ne kawai don ƙirƙirar manhajar relay kuma OmniRoute ba zai taɓa adana shi ba.
settings.denoRelayFreeTierNote: Deno Deploy v2 yana aiki a kan cibiyar sadarwar edge ta duniya. Matakin kyauta: buƙatu miliyan 1 da zirga-zirgar bayanai masu fita 100GiB a kowane wata, babu iyakar CPU ga kowace buƙata, har zuwa manhajoji 20 masu aiki da yankuna na musamman 50.
settings.cloudflareRelaySuccess: An yi nasarar tura Cloudflare Relay
settings.cloudflareRelayWarning: Yana tura Cloudflare Worker wanda ke wakiltar buƙatun LLM ta hanyar cibiyar sadarwar edge ta Cloudflare — yana ɓoye IP na mai masauki a bayan adiresoshin Cloudflare masu sauyawa. Worker yana tilasta amfani da sirrin tantancewa na sau ɗaya domin kada a sake amfani da URL na workers.dev na jama'a a matsayin buɗaɗɗen relay.
settings.cloudflareRelayTokenHowto: Ƙirƙiri API token a ƙarƙashin My Profile -> API Tokens -> Create Token -> Custom Token -> Account / Workers Scripts / Edit.
settings.cloudflareRelayAccountIdHint: Ana samunsa a gefen dama na shafin bayani na dashboard na Cloudflare.
settings.cloudflareRelayApiTokenHint: Yana buƙatar izinin 'Workers Scripts: Edit'. Ana amfani da token ɗin ne kawai lokacin turawa kuma ba a taɓa adana shi ba.
settings.cloudflareRelayFreeTierNote: Matakin kyauta: buƙatu 100,000 a rana ga kowane asusun Cloudflare.
settings.cloudflareRelayCredsRequired: Ana buƙatar ID na Asusun da API Token
settings.modelLockoutPageDescription: Saita waɗanne lambobin kuskuren HTTP ne ke jawo kullewar kowane samfur da kuma sarrafa halayyar lokacin jira.
settings.modelLockoutLoadFailed: An kasa loda saitunan kulle samfur
settings.modelLockoutSaveFailed: An kasa adana saitunan kulle samfur
settings.modelLockoutBaseRangeError: Dole ne Lokacin Jira na Farko ya kasance tsakanin 5,000ms da 600,000ms
settings.modelLockoutMaxRangeError: Dole ne Matsakaicin Lokacin Jira ya kasance tsakanin 5,000ms da 3,600,000ms
settings.modelLockoutOrderError: Dole ne Matsakaicin Lokacin Jira ya fi ko ya yi daidai da Lokacin Jira na Farko
settings.modelLockoutStepsRangeError: Dole ne Matsakaicin Matakan Backoff ya kasance tsakanin 0 da 20
settings.modelLockoutEnabledDescription: Idan an kunna, za a kulle samfuran da suka gaza da lambobin kuskuren da aka saita na ɗan lokaci domin hana maimaita ƙoƙarin ba iyaka.
settings.modelLockoutErrorCodesDescription: Lambobin matsayin HTTP da ke jawo kulle samfur. Rubuta lamba sannan danna Ƙara, ko zaɓa daga shawarwari.
settings.modelLockoutBaseCooldownDescription: Tsawon lokacin jira na farko a cikin milliseƙan kafin a sake gwada samfur.
settings.modelLockoutMaxCooldownDescription: Matsakaicin tsawon lokacin jira a cikin milliseƙan. Yana hana kullewa na dogon lokaci fiye da kima.
settings.modelLockoutExponentialBackoffDescriptio: Idan an kunna, kowace gazawa a jere tana ƙara tsawon lokacin dakatawa ninki-ninki.
settings.modelLockoutMaxBackoffStepsDescription: Matsakaicin adadin matakan jinkirin sake gwadawa kafin lokacin dakatawa ya daina ƙaruwa. A yawancin saituna, ana fara kai iyakar Max Cooldown, don haka wannan yana zama iyakar kariya idan an ƙara Max Cooldown.
settings.disableSessionStickinessDesc: Haɗakan round-robin da na bazuwar suna sauyawa zuwa wani haɗin sadarwa daban a kowace buƙata maimakon ɗaure duk tattaunawa da haɗin sadarwa guda bisa hash na saƙon farko. A bar shi a kashe don kiyaye samun nasarar prompt-cache a hirarraki masu matakai da yawa. Keɓantattun saitunan kowane haɗaka suna da fifiko.
settings.promptCacheAffinityDesc: Fi son asusun mai samarwa ɗaya don maɓallan prompt-cache da suka dace, tare da kiyaye sauyawa idan akwai matsalar aiki ko an kai iyakar kaso.
settings.reasoningTokenBufferDesc: Ba da damar rautawar haɗaka ta ƙara sararin max_tokens kawai ga sanannun samfurorin tunani idan cikakkiyar ajiyar ta shiga cikin sananniyar iyakar fitarwa.
settings.zeroLatencyOptimizationsDesc: Zaɓi shiga cikin hedging, tsallake-tsallaken TTFT na hasashe, da matse madadin da wuri. A bar shi a kashe don hana waɗannan fasalolin rage jinkiri yin gasa da wuraren da aka nufa ko matse buƙatun madadin.
settings.credentialRedactionDesc: Ɓoye maɓallan API, tokens, da sirrika daga mahallin da ake aikawa ga masu samarwa da kuma daga martani.
settings.enableCredentialRedactionDesc: Yana cire maɓallan API, tokens, maɓallan sirri, da JWTs daga saƙonni, kiran kayan aiki, da martani.
settings.modalityBridgeIntro: Mayar da abun ciki mai kafofin watsa labarai da yawa zuwa rubutu kafin ya isa ga samfuran da ke karɓar rubutu kawai. Akwai gadar Vision, Audio, da Video, kuma ana iya saita su.
settings.modalityBridgeVisionDesc: Bayyana hotuna da samfurin gani sannan a ci gaba da samfurin rubutu da mai amfani ya zaɓa.
settings.modalityBridgeModeAutoHint: Tsohuwar dabara: sake rauta samfura ɗaya-ɗaya marasa bayanan shaida; in ba haka ba, a bayyana hotunan.
settings.modalityBridgeModeDescribeHint: Samfurin da ka zaɓa ne koyaushe yake amsawa; ana maye gurbin hotuna da bayanan rubutu.
settings.modalityBridgeModeRerouteHint: Aika dukkan buƙatar zuwa mafi kyawun samfurin da ke iya gani (yana komawa ga bayyana idan babu wanda za a iya amfani da shi).
settings.modalityBridgeVisionModelAuto: Ta atomatik (mafi kyau da ake da shi)
settings.modalityBridgeTaskAwareDesc: Haɗa tambayar mai amfani a matsayin abin da za a mayar da hankali a kai domin samfurin gani ya bayyana abin da ya dace kuma ya kwafe rubutun da ake iya gani.
settings.visionMaxCharsHint: Sanya iyaka ga tsawon bayanin samfurin gani. 0 = babu iyaka — ƙara shi don ayyukan OCR masu buƙatar cikakken bayani.
settings.modalityBridgeCacheEnabled: Adana bayanin hotuna a ma’ajiyar wucin gadi
settings.modalityBridgeCacheEnabledDesc: Sake amfani da bayanin hotuna iri ɗaya (mai mabuɗin SHA-256, a cikin ƙwaƙwalwa).
settings.modalityBridgeCacheMaxEntries: Matsakaicin adadin shigarwa a ma’ajiyar wucin gadi
settings.modalityBridgeStatsCacheHits: samun bayanai daga ma’ajiyar wucin gadi
settings.modalityBridgeTestOk: Gada tana aiki — {model} ya bayyana hoto {count}
settings.modalityBridgeTestReroute: Gada ta sake tura buƙatar zuwa {model}
settings.modalityBridgeTestNoop: Gada ba ta kunna ba (mai yiwuwa samfurin yana tallafa wa gani kai tsaye ko kuma an kashe gadar)
settings.modalityBridgeAudioComingSoon: Gadar Sauti (magana → rubutu ta /v1/audio/transcriptions) za ta zo a fitowa ta gaba. An riga an keɓe mabuɗan saitunanta.
settings.modalityBridgeMovedBody: Saitunan Gadar Gani yanzu suna cikin shafin Gadar Nau’in Bayanai na musamman.
settings.modalityBridgeAudioDesc: Mayar da sauti zuwa rubutu ta amfani da samfurin magana-zuwa-rubutu kafin a ci gaba da samfurin rubutu da aka zaɓa.
settings.modalityBridgeAudioEnabledDesc: Sauya sassan sauti da rubutattun maganganunsu idan samfurin da ake nufi ba zai iya sarrafa sauti ba.
settings.modalityBridgeAudioModelAuto: Na atomatik (mai samar da STT na farko da aka haɗa)
settings.modalityBridgeAudioMaxClips: Matsakaicin guntayen sauti a kowace buƙata
settings.modalityBridgeAudioTestOk: Gadar Sauti na aiki — {model} ya mayar da shirye-shiryen sauti guda {count} zuwa rubutu
settings.modalityBridgeAudioTestNoop: Gadar Sauti ba ta fara aiki ba (mai yiwuwa samfurin da ake nufi yana tallafa wa sauti, babu mai samar da STT da aka haɗa, ko kuma an kashe gadar)
settings.modalityBridgeVideoDesc: Ɗauki firamomin bidiyo a matsayin samfuri, bayyana su da samfurin gani, sannan a ci gaba da samfurin rubutu da aka zaɓa.
settings.modalityBridgeVideoRuntimeInstall: Shigar da FFmpeg da ffprobe a PATH na uwar garken don ba da damar cire bayanai daga bidiyo.
settings.modalityBridgeVideoEnabledDesc: Sauya sassan bidiyo da bayanan firam masu tambarin lokaci idan samfurin da ake nufi ba zai iya sarrafa bidiyo ba.
settings.modalityBridgeVideoMaxVideos: Matsakaicin adadin bidiyoyi a kowace buƙata
settings.modelRoutingDescriptionPlaceholder: Tura samfuran Opus zuwa haɗin frontier

settings.oneproxySyncSuccess: An daidaita proxies {total} ({added} sababbi, an sabunta {updated})

omniglyph.description: Matsa mahallin bayani a matsayin hoto. Yana mayar da umarnin tsarin, takardun kayan aiki, da tarihin da ke cike da bayanai zuwa ƙananan shafukan PNG domin hanyar Claude Fable 5 da aka auna. Kunshin OmniGlyph da aka wallafa yana kuma samar da masu sauyawa na asali na GPT 5.6, amma OmniRoute yana barin waɗannan hanyoyin a rufe idan an samu gazawa har sai an tabbatar da amincin mai samarwa da rasitocin karantawa.

model.label: Samfuri
model.why: Hanyar Fable 5 da aka auna kaɗai ce aka kunna a OmniRoute. Kunshin yana goyon bayan GPT 5.6 ta fuskar tsari, amma har yanzu an toshe shi har sai an samu rasitin mai samar da shi; iyalai da ba a tabbatar da su ba kamar Grok suna ci gaba da amfani da rubutu kawai.

transport.label: Isarwa
transport.why: Masu tarawa na iya sake ɗaukar samfurin hotuna su lalata sauƙin karantawa — hanyar mai samarwa kai tsaye kaɗai ce abin dogaro.

format.label: Tsari
format.why: Dole ne jikin ya dace da tsarin isarwar mai samarwa: Claude Messages, OpenAI Chat Completions, ko shigarwar OpenAI Responses input[] ta asali.

profitable.label: Mai riba
profitable.why: Ƙofar ainihin kuɗin facin 28px ce ke yanke shawara ga kowace buƙata; ƙaramin rubutu ko wanda ba shi da cunkoso yana wucewa ba tare da an taɓa shi ba.

omniglyph.enableDescription: Yana aiki a ƙarshe cikin jerin bayan injinan rubutu sun tsaftace buƙatar, ta amfani da tsarin isarwar mai samarwa na asali; ana matsa buƙatun OpenAI Chat/Responses bayan fassara domin a kiyaye tsarinsu. Haka kuma yana iya aiki shi kaɗai ta yanayin omniglyph. Wannan samfoti ne kuma yana kasancewa a kashe ta tsohuwa har sai an kammala tabbatarwa daga farko zuwa ƙarshe.
omniglyph.profileDescription: Bayanan martaba iyaka ce ta sama, ba ta ƙasa ba: ba za a iya sassauta bayanan martaba masu tsauri ta hanyar keɓancewar kowane mataki ba. An auna wannan a wannan codebase: tare da coding-safe ko balanced, zaman da bai tara tarihi ba tukuna ba ya matse komai, domin dukansu suna ƙara mafi ƙarancin adadin haruffa kuma suna barin system prompt, tool schemas da tool results a yanayinsu na asali.

aggressive.label: Mai tsauri (tsoho)
aggressive.description: Manufar da rasitocin da aka wallafa suka auna. Yana mayar da system prompt, takardun kayan aiki da tarihin mai cunkoso zuwa hotuna.

balanced.label: Daidaitacce
balanced.description: Yana barin yanayin aiki na yanzu a asalinsa kuma yana kare zagaye 8 na ƙarshe; yana taƙaita tsohon tarihin da aka rufe kawai.

passthrough.description: Yana sarrafa hanya ba tare da sauya komai ba. Ana tsallake engine ɗin kuma a tura buƙatar yadda take ba tare da an taɓa ta ba.

landing.heroDescription: Wakilin wurin haɗin AI mai dashboard na yanar gizo - Sigar JavaScript ta CLIProxyAPI. Yana aiki cikin sauƙi tare da Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cline, RooCode, da sauran kayan aikin CLI.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Duk abin da kuke buƙata don sarrafa ababen more rayuwa na AI a wuri guda, an gina shi don faɗaɗawa.
landing.featureUnifiedEndpointDesc: Sami damar amfani da duk masu samarwa ta hanyar daidaitaccen URL na API guda ɗaya.
landing.featureEasySetupDesc: Fara aiki cikin mintuna ta amfani da umarnin npx.
landing.featureModelFallbackDesc: Sauya masu samarwa ta atomatik idan an sami gazawa ko jinkiri mai yawa.
landing.featureUsageTrackingDesc: Cikakken nazari da sa ido kan farashi a dukkan samfura.
landing.featureOAuthApiKeysDesc: Sarrafa bayanan shiga cikin aminci a ma'ajiya guda ɗaya.
landing.featureCloudSyncDesc: Daidaita saitunanka tsakanin na'urori nan take.
landing.featureCliSupportDesc: Yana aiki tare da Claude Code, Codex, Cline, Cursor, da sauransu.
landing.featureDashboardDesc: Allon bayanai na gani don nazarin zirga-zirga a ainihin lokaci.
landing.howItWorksDescription: Bayanai suna gudana cikin sauƙi daga manhajarka ta cikin matakinmu na sarrafa hanyoyi mai basira zuwa mafi kyawun mai samarwa don aikin.
landing.howItWorksStep1Description: Buƙatunku suna farawa daga kayan aikin da kuka fi so ko haɗaɗɗen SDK ɗinmu. Kawai ku canza URL na tushe.
landing.howItWorksStep2Description: Injinmu yana nazarin umarnin, yana duba lafiyar masu samar da sabis, sannan yana zaɓar hanya mafi ƙarancin jinkiri ko farashi.
landing.howItWorksStep3Description: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, ko wasu suna aiwatar da buƙatar nan take.
landing.getStartedDescription: Shigar da OmniRoute, saita masu samar da sabis ɗinku ta dashboard na yanar gizo, sannan ku fara karkatar da buƙatun AI.
landing.installStepDescription: Gudanar da umarnin npx don fara sabar nan take
landing.openDashboardStepDescription: Saita masu samar da sabis da maɓallan API ta hanyar mahaɗin yanar gizo
landing.routeRequestsStepDescription: Saita kayan aikin CLI ɗinku su yi amfani da {endpoint}
landing.configureProvidersNote: 📝 Saita masu samar da sabis a dashboard ko amfani da sauye-sauyen muhalli
landing.footerTagline: Haɗaɗɗen endpoint don samar da abun ciki ta AI. Haɗa, tsara turawa, da sarrafa masu samar da AI ɗinku cikin sauƙi.
landing.interactiveDiagram: Ana iya ganin zane mai mu'amala a kan kwamfutar tebur
landing.ctaTitle: Kun Shirya Don Sauƙaƙa Kayan Aikin AI Naku?
landing.ctaDescription: Ku haɗu da masu haɓaka software waɗanda ke sauƙaƙa haɗa AI ɗinsu da OmniRoute. Buɗaɗɗen tushe ne kuma kyauta ne don farawa.
landing.footerDescription: Haɗaɗɗiyar hanyar mu'amala don kayan aikin AI na zamani. Amintacciya, mai sauƙin sa ido, kuma mai iya faɗaɗawa.

docs.deploySetupText: Jagorar shigarwa mataki-mataki, daidaita muhalli, da jagorar fara gudanar da OmniRoute.
docs.deployElectronText: Gudanar da OmniRoute a matsayin manhajar kwamfuta ta asali a Windows, macOS, da Linux.
docs.deployDockerText: Turawa a cikin kwantena tare da Docker Compose; a shirye don tsarin samarwa da Kubernetes.
docs.deployVmText: Gudanar da shi da kanka a kan kowace Linux VM. Ya haɗa da systemd unit, jujjuyawar log, da kayan aikin madadin bayanai.
docs.deployFlyText: Tura zuwa yanayin gudanarwa na gefen Fly.io da fly.toml guda ɗaya da umarnin turawa guda ɗaya.
docs.deployPwaText: Shigar da OmniRoute a matsayin Progressive Web App a kan Android, iOS, da burauzar kwamfuta.
docs.deployTermuxText: Gudanar da OmniRoute ba tare da mahaɗar gani ba a kan Android ta hanyar Termux. Shiga dashboard daga burauzar wayarka.
docs.featureRoutingTitle: Tura Buƙatu Tsakanin Masu Samarwa da Yawa
docs.featureRoutingText: Tura buƙatu zuwa masu samar da AI sama da 30 ta endpoint guda ɗaya mai dacewa da OpenAI. Yana tallafa wa API na chat, responses, audio, da image.
docs.featureCombosText: Ƙirƙiri haɗin samfura tare da jerin madadin da dabarun daidaitawa: round-robin, fifiko, bazuwar zaɓi, mafi ƙarancin amfani, da inganta farashi.
docs.featureUsageText: Ƙirga token a ainihin lokaci, lissafin farashi na kowane mai samarwa/samfuri, da cikakken rarrabuwar amfani bisa API key da asusu.
docs.featureAnalyticsText: Nazarin gani tare da jadawali don buƙatu, tokens, kurakurai, jinkiri, farashi, da shaharar samfura a tsawon lokaci.
docs.featureHealthText: Binciken lafiya kai-tsaye, matsayin masu samarwa, yanayin circuit breaker, da gano rate limit ta atomatik tare da exponential backoff.
docs.featureCliText: Sarrafa saitunan IDE, fitarwa/shigo da kwafin ajiya, gano bayanan martabar Codex, da daidaita saituna daga dashboard.
docs.featureSecurityText: Tabbatar da izini ta API key, tace IP, kariya daga prompt injection, manufofin domain, sarrafa zaman aiki, da rubuta bayanan bincike.
docs.featureCloudSyncText: Daidaita saitunanka zuwa Cloudflare Workers don samun damar nesa tare da bayanan sirri da aka ɓoye da sauyawa ta atomatik idan an samu matsala.
docs.providersAcrossConnectionTypes: Masu samarwa {count} a nau'ikan haɗi uku.
docs.useCaseSingleEndpointTitle: Endpoint guda ɗaya don masu samarwa da yawa
docs.useCaseSingleEndpointText: Saita clients su yi amfani da base URL guda ɗaya sannan a yi routing bisa prefix na model (misali: gh/, cc/, kr/, openai/).
docs.useCaseFallbackTitle: Fallback da sauya model ta amfani da combos
docs.useCaseFallbackText: Ƙirƙiri combo models a Dashboard kuma ka bar client config ba tare da sauyi ba yayin da masu samarwa ke sauyawa a ciki.
docs.useCaseUsageVisibilityText: Bibiyi tokens da farashi bisa mai samarwa, account, da API key a shafukan Usage da Analytics.
docs.clientCodexBullet1: Yi amfani da model IDs tare da
docs.clientCodexBullet2: Samfuran dangin Codex suna yin routing ta atomatik zuwa
docs.clientCodexBullet3: Samfuran da ba na Codex ba suna ci gaba ta
docs.clientCursorBullet2: Haɗin OAuth - shiga daga shafin Providers.
docs.clientWindsurfBullet1: Yi amfani da OmniRoute a matsayin OpenAI-compatible base URL kuma ka riƙe takamaiman provider prefixes don routing mai ƙayyadadden tsari.
docs.clientWindsurfBullet2: Saita models su yi amfani da `/v1/chat/completions` don zirga-zirgar gama-gari, kuma ka kiyaye `/v1/responses` don Codex-style flows.
docs.clientWindsurfBullet3: Yi amfani da Dashboard -> CLI Tools don samun jagorar daidaita Windsurf da aka riga aka shirya.
docs.clientClineBullet1: Cline yana aiki mafi kyau da takamaiman prefix na provider/model domin kada router ya taɓa yin hasashen backend.
docs.clientClineBullet2: Yi amfani da `/v1/chat/completions` don samfura na gama-gari, sannan ka sake amfani da OmniRoute base URL iri ɗaya a asusu daban-daban.
docs.clientClineBullet3: Yi amfani da dashboard na Providers don tabbatar da OAuth/API key kafin binciken matsalolin lokacin gudanar da Cline.
docs.clientKimiBullet1: Yi amfani da OmniRoute a matsayin tabbataccen base URL yayin sauya asusu ko haɗe-haɗen provider da ke ƙarƙashinsa.
docs.clientKimiBullet2: Fi son samfura masu prefix a tsarin aikin coding domin fallback da audit trail su kasance a bayyane.
docs.clientKimiBullet3: Yi amfani da `/v1/responses` idan kana son routing na asali irin na Responses ga clients masu amfani da tools.
docs.protocolsDescription: OmniRoute yana samar da ƙa'idojin gudanarwa guda biyu ban da APIs masu dacewa da OpenAI: MCP don aiwatar da tools, da A2A don workflows tsakanin agents.
docs.protocolMcpDesc: Yi amfani da MCP ta hanyar stdio domin bai wa clients damar ganowa da kiran tools na OmniRoute tare da damar ganin bayanan audit.
docs.protocolMcpStep2: Saita MCP client ɗinka ya yi amfani da stdio transport.
docs.protocolMcpStep3: Kira `omniroute_get_health` da `omniroute_list_combos` don tabbatar da haɗin.
docs.protocolA2aDesc: Yi amfani da A2A JSON-RPC don aika tasks a yanayin synchronous ko ta SSE streaming.
docs.protocolA2aStep3: Sarrafa lifecycle na task da `tasks/get` da `tasks/cancel`.
docs.protocolTroubleshooting1: Idan matsayin MCP yana offline, tabbatar cewa process na stdio yana gudana kuma heartbeat file yana ci gaba da sabuntawa.
docs.protocolTroubleshooting2: Idan tasks na A2A suka ci gaba da kasancewa a `working`, bincika `/api/a2a/tasks/:id` da stream events don gano terminal state.
docs.protocolTroubleshooting3: Yi amfani da `/dashboard/mcp` da `/dashboard/a2a` don sarrafa ayyuka da ganin bayanan audit.

docs.mgmtProxiesHealthNote: Samo ma'aunin health na awa 24/mai ci gaba ga kowane proxy da aka adana daga proxy logs.

docs.modelPrefixesDescriptionEnd: yana tura buƙata zuwa GitHub Copilot.
docs.troubleshootingModelRouting: Idan abokin ciniki ya gaza wajen tura samfurin, yi amfani da provider/model a sarari (misali: gh/gpt-5.1-codex).
docs.troubleshootingAmbiguousModels: Idan ka sami kurakuran model masu shubuha, zaɓi prefix na mai samarwa maimakon model ID kaɗai.
docs.troubleshootingCodexFamily: Don models na dangin GitHub Codex, bar model a matsayin gh/codex-model; router zai zaɓi /responses ta atomatik.
docs.troubleshootingTestConnection: Yi amfani da Dashboard > Providers > Test Connection kafin gwadawa daga IDEs ko abokan ciniki na waje.
docs.troubleshootingCircuitBreaker: Idan mai samarwa ya nuna circuit breaker a buɗe, jira lokacin hucewa ko duba shafin Health don ƙarin bayani.
docs.troubleshootingOAuth: Ga masu samarwa na OAuth, sake tantancewa idan tokens sun ƙare. Duba alamar matsayi a katin mai samarwa.

docs.endpointBatchesNote: Sarrafa buƙatun API masu yawa a rukuni.

docs.mcpToolsDescription: OmniRoute yana samar da kayan aiki {count} ta hanyar Model Context Protocol don tsara ayyukan wakilai.
docs.mcpToolsRoutingDesc: Binciken lafiyar tsarin, sarrafa combo, sa ido kan quota, rahoton kuɗi, da samun dama ga kundin samfura.
docs.mcpToolsOperationsDesc: Kwaikwayon hanyar tura buƙatu, kariyar kasafin kuɗi, sauya dabaru, furofayilolin juriya, da ma'aunan masu samarwa.
docs.mcpToolsCacheDesc: Duba ƙididdigar ma'ajiyar wucin gadi sannan share ma'ajiyoyin ma'ana ko na sa hannu.
docs.mcpToolsCompressionDesc: Saita matsewar RTK/Brotli, musanya injina, sannan bincika nazarin matsewa bisa combo.
docs.mcpToolsOneProxyDesc: Sarrafa proxy masu fita, sauya IP na gidaje, sannan bincika lafiyar proxy.
docs.mcpToolsMemoryDesc: Nema, ƙara, da share bayanan ƙwaƙwalwar tattaunawa masu ɗorewa.
docs.mcpToolsSkillsDesc: Jera, kunna, aiwatar, da sa ido kan aiwatar da ƙwarewa na musamman.
docs.featureAutoComboText: Ƙirƙiri ingantattun combo ta atomatik bisa masu samarwarka da aka haɗa, tsarin amfani, da damar samfura.
docs.featureSearchText: Haɗaɗɗen binciken yanar gizo tare da masu samarwa 5 (Serper, Brave, Exa, Tavily, Perplexity), gami da nazari da bibiyar kuɗi.
docs.featureMemoryText: Ƙwaƙwalwar tattaunawa mai ɗorewa tare da cire bayanai, shigarwa, dawo da bayanai, da taƙaitawa a zaman aiki daban-daban.
docs.featureSkillsText: Tsarin ƙwarewa mai faɗaɗawa tare da ginannun ƙwarewa da na musamman, aiwatarwa a sandbox, katse buƙatu, da shigar da mahallin bayani.
docs.featureAcpText: Rajistar Agent Communication Protocol (ACP) don gudanar da tsarin ayyuka tsakanin wakilai da tsara amfani da kayan aiki.
docs.protocolAcpDesc: Yi rajista da sarrafa wakilai ta rajistar ACP don sadarwa tsakanin wakilai da raba kayan aiki.
docs.protocolAcpStep1: Je zuwa Dashboard → Agents don duba wakilan ACP da aka yi wa rajista.
docs.protocolAcpStep2: Yi wa sabbin wakilai rajista tare da iyawarsu da saitunan endpoint.
docs.protocolAcpStep3: Yi amfani da CLI Tools don saita tashoshin sadarwar wakilai.

legal.privacyMetadataDescription: Manufar keɓantawa ta mai tsara hanyoyin wakili na AI API na OmniRoute.
legal.termsMetadataDescription: Sharuɗɗan sabis na mai tsara hanyoyin wakili na AI API na OmniRoute.
legal.privacySection1Title: 1. Tsarin da ke Bai wa Na'urar Gida Fifiko
legal.privacySection1Text: An tsara OmniRoute a matsayin manhajar da ke bai wa na'urar gida fifiko. Ana sarrafa da adana dukkan bayanai gaba ɗaya a kan na'urarka. Babu wata uwar garken tsakiya da ke tattara bayananka.
legal.privacyDataStoredIn: Ana adana bayanai masu zuwa a kan na'urarka a cikin
legal.privacyDataProviderConfigurationsDesc: URLs na haɗi, nau'ikan masu samar da sabis, da saitunan fifiko
legal.privacyDataApiKeysDesc: ana ɓoye su sannan a adana su a cikin na'urarka don tabbatar da izini tare da masu samar da AI
legal.privacyDataUsageLogsDesc: adadin buƙatu, yawan amfani da token, sunayen samfura, lokutan faruwa, da lokutan amsawa
legal.privacyDataApplicationSettingsDesc: zaɓin jigo, dabarar tsara hanya, da saitunan haɗaka
legal.privacySection3Text: OmniRoute ba ya tattara telemetry, bayanan nazari, ko rahotannin rushewar manhaja. Ba a aika mana ko wani ɓangare na uku da wani bayani. Tsarin amfani da kake yi, kiran API, da saitunanka suna kasancewa masu cikakken sirri.
legal.privacySection4Title: 4. Masu Samar da AI na Ɓangare na Uku
legal.privacySection4Text: Lokacin da ka yi kiran API ta hanyar OmniRoute, ana tura buƙatunka zuwa masu samar da AI da ka saita (misali: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google). Waɗannan masu samarwa suna da nasu manufofin keɓantawa waɗanda ke tsara yadda suke sarrafa bayananka. Da fatan za a duba:
legal.privacySection5Text: Idan ka kunna fasalin daidaitawa da cloud na zaɓi, ana iya aika saitunan masu samar da sabis da maɓallan API zuwa endpoint na cloud da aka saita. An kashe wannan fasalin a matsayin tsohon saiti kuma sai an amince da shi a sarari kafin a kunna shi.
legal.privacyLoggingIntro: Ana iya saita rajistan buƙatu ta saitunan allon sarrafawa. Za ka iya:
legal.privacySection7TextStart: Tun da ana adana dukkan bayanai a cikin na'urarka, kana da cikakken iko. Za ka iya share bayananka a kowane lokaci ta hanyar cire directory ɗin
legal.privacySection7TextEnd: ko amfani da fasalolin yin madadin database da dawo da shi a cikin dashboard.
legal.termsSection1Text: OmniRoute wakili ne mai tsara hanyoyin API na AI wanda ke bai wa aiki a gida fifiko kuma yake aiki gaba ɗaya a kan na'urarka. Yana tsara buƙatu zuwa masu samar da AI da yawa tare da daidaita nauyin aiki, sauyawa idan an samu matsala, da bin diddigin amfani.
legal.termsSection2Title: 2. Nauyin da ke Kan Mai Amfani
legal.termsResponsibilityApiKeys: Kai kaɗai ne ke da alhakin sarrafa maɓallan API da bayanan shaidarka don masu samar da AI na ɓangare na uku (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, da sauransu).
legal.termsResponsibilityCompliance: Dole ne ka bi sharuɗɗan sabis na kowane mai samar da AI wanda kake samun damar API ɗinsa ta hanyar OmniRoute.
legal.termsResponsibilitySecurity: Kai ne ke da alhakin tsaron shigarwar OmniRoute da ke na'urarka, ciki har da saita kalmar sirri da taƙaita damar hanyar sadarwa.
legal.termsSection3Text: OmniRoute yana aiki a matsayin wakili na tsaka-tsaki. Ana sauya tsarin kiran API da aka aika zuwa OmniRoute sannan a tura su zuwa masu samar da AI da ka saita. OmniRoute ba ya gyara abin da ke cikin buƙatunka ko amsoshinka, sai dai sauya ƙa'idar sadarwa da ya zama dole.
legal.termsDataStoredLocally: Ana adana dukkan bayanai a cikin na'urar ku a ma'ajiyar bayanai ta SQLite.
legal.termsNoTransmission: OmniRoute ba ya aika wasu bayanai zuwa sabar waje sai idan kun kunna fasalolin aiki tare ta gajimare da kanku.
legal.termsDataLocationText: Ana adana rajistan ayyukan amfani, maɓallan API, da saituna a cikin
legal.termsSection5Text: Ana samar da OmniRoute "kamar yadda yake" ba tare da kowane irin garanti ba. Ba mu da alhakin duk wani kuɗi da aka kashe ta hanyar amfani da API, katsewar sabis, ko asarar bayanai. Koyaushe ku riƙa yin kwafin ajiyar saitunanku.
legal.termsSection6Text: OmniRoute manhaja ce mai buɗaɗɗen tushe. Kuna da ’yancin dubawa, gyarawa, da rarraba ta bisa sharuɗɗan lasisinta.

oauthModal.title: Haɗa {providerName}

oauthModal.googleLoopbackTitle: Ba za a iya kammala shiga ta Google daga wannan adireshin ba
oauthModal.googleLoopbackWhatHappens: Google yana fitar da lambar izini ne kawai idan ana iya isa ga {redirectUri} daga burauzar da ta amince da shiga. A nan, wannan adireshin yana nuni zuwa wannan kwamfutar, ba zuwa sabar OmniRoute ba — saboda haka allon amincewa yana makalewa maimakon ya tura zuwa wani wuri, kuma babu URL na callback da za a kwafa.
oauthModal.googleLoopbackRecommended: An ba da shawara — gudanar da wannan a kwamfutarka, sannan liƙa sakamakon a ƙasa:
oauthModal.googleLoopbackHelperNote: Yana buɗe amincewar Google a kwamfutarka (inda 127.0.0.1 yake aiki) kuma yana fitar da blob na layi ɗaya na omniroute-cred-v1.…. Liƙa wannan blob ɗin cikin filin Mataki na 2 da ke ƙasa — yana karɓar blob na bayanan shaidarka da kuma URL na callback.
oauthModal.googleLoopbackTunnelLabel: Ko kuma tura tashar dashboard ta hanyar SSH sannan ka sake loda OmniRoute ta cikin tunnel ɗin:
oauthModal.googleLoopbackTunnelNote: Sauya {userPlaceholder} da sunan mai amfani na SSH ɗinka, ka bar terminal ɗin a buɗe, sannan ka buɗe {localUrl} kuma ka sake haɗawa daga can.
oauthModal.googleLoopbackHeadlessAlt: Don amfani gaba ɗaya ba tare da GUI ba kuma babu callback na gida, saita bayanan shaidarka na Google OAuth tare da URL na tushe na jama'a.
oauthModal.remoteAccessInfo: Samun dama daga nesa: Tun da kana shiga OmniRoute daga nesa, bayan bayar da izini za ka ga shafin kuskure (ba a sami localhost ba). Wannan al'ada ce — kawai kwafi cikakken URL daga sandar adireshin burauzarka sannan ka liƙa shi a ƙasa.
oauthModal.loopbackMismatchTitle: Ba za a iya kammala shiga daga wannan adireshin ba
oauthModal.loopbackMismatchExplanation: Bayan ka amince da shiga, {providerName} koyaushe yana mayar da burauzar zuwa {redirectUri}. Wannan adireshin yana nuni zuwa kwamfutar da ke gudanar da wannan burauzar, ba zuwa sabar OmniRoute ba — saboda haka lambar izini ba ta taɓa isa OmniRoute, kuma mai samarwa ya kasa kammala shiga ba tare da nuna kuskure ba.
oauthModal.loopbackMismatchStep1: A wannan kwamfutar, buɗe terminal sannan ka fara SSH tunnel zuwa sabar OmniRoute:
oauthModal.loopbackMismatchStep1Note: Sauya {userPlaceholder} da sunan mai amfani na SSH ɗinka. Bar wannan terminal ɗin a buɗe har sai haɗin ya nuna yana aiki — ana buƙatar duka tashoshin biyu: ɗaya yana hidimar dashboard, ɗayan kuma yana karɓar callback.
oauthModal.loopbackMismatchStep2: A wannan burauzar, sake buɗe OmniRoute ta cikin tunnel ɗin:
oauthModal.loopbackMismatchStep3: Sannan ka sake haɗa {providerName} daga sabon tab ɗin. Yanzu callback zai isa sabar kuma za a kammala shiga yadda ya kamata.
oauthModal.loopbackMismatchAlternative: Ba ka da damar SSH? Idan wannan mai samarwar yana da tab na shigo da token, yi haɗi da token maimakon haka — wannan hanyar ba ta amfani da callback na loopback.
oauthModal.step1OpenUrl: Mataki na 1: Buɗe wannan URL a burauzarka
oauthModal.step2PasteCallback: Mataki na 2: Liƙa URL na callback ko lambar izini a nan
oauthModal.step2Hint: Bayan bayar da izini, liƙa cikakken URL na callback. Don Claude Code da Cline, za ka iya liƙa lambar tantancewa kai tsaye, misali code#state.
oauthModal.errorSessionIncomplete: Zaman OAuth bai cika ba (babu redirect URI ko code verifier). Sake fara haɗin sannan ka sake gwadawa.
oauthModal.errorGoogleRedirectMismatch: redirect_uri_mismatch: Bayanan shaidar Google OAuth na asali suna aiki ne kawai a localhost. Don amfani daga nesa, saita bayanan shaidarka na OAuth ta hanyar environment variables: ANTIGRAVITY_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID da ANTIGRAVITY_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET. Duba sashen README mai suna 'OAuth on a Remote Server'.
oauthModal.errorBrowserUnavailable: Ba a samun OAuth na burauza ga wannan mai samarwa a muhallin da ake ciki yanzu. Yi amfani da hanyar auth da ake tallafawa maimakon haka.

oauthModal.windsurfPasteDescription: A cikin Windsurf / VS Code IDE, gudanar da umarnin "Windsurf: Provide Auth Token" daga jerin umarni (ko danna maɓallin Jupyter "Get Windsurf Authentication Token"), sannan kwafi token ɗin da aka nuna ka manna shi a ƙasa. oauthModal.grokAuthJsonDescription: Manna DUKKAN abubuwan da ke cikin ~/.grok/auth.json (ba filin JWT "key" kaɗai ba). JWT shi kaɗai ba shi da refresh_token, don haka haɗin zai katse bayan wa'adinsa ya ƙare (#7610). Ka fi amfani da taga ta musamman ta Shigo da auth.json idan tana samuwa.

quotaShare.conceptIntro: Quota Share yana raba ƙotar mai samarwa tsakanin maɓallan API da yawa ta amfani da adalcin rabo mai kiyaye aiki: kowane maɓalli yana samun kaso gwargwadon nauyinsa, amma yana iya aro daga ragowar da ba a yi amfani da shi ba ba tare da wuce iyakar gaba ɗaya ba.

quotaShare.conceptBorrowing: Aron kaso: maɓallai za su iya amfani da ragowar kaso na wasu ba tare da ƙetare iyaka ba
quotaShare.conceptGlobalCap: Ƙaƙƙarfan iyakar gaba ɗaya: ba a taɓa ƙetare cikakkiyar iyakar mai samarwa ba
quotaShare.conceptWindows: Lokuta: 5h, na awa-awa, na yau da kullum, na mako-mako, na wata-wata — ana bibiyar kowanne daban
quotaShare.conceptKeyHowDesc: Ƙirƙiri maɓallin kamar yadda aka saba a API Keys — zai bayyana kai tsaye a matakin maɓalli na mayen. Yi wa Exclusive alama a can don keɓe shi ga kaso kawai. Babu wani matakin kunnawa na daban.
quotaShare.conceptExclusiveDesc: Keɓantaccen maɓalli yana gani/amfani ne kawai da samfuran quotaShared-* na tafkin — an ɓoye duk sauran samfura daga /v1/models ɗinsa kuma an toshe su.

quotaShare.wizardStep1Subtitle: Zaɓi asusun mai samarwa wanda wannan tafki zai raba masa kaso, sannan saita suna da tsohuwar manufa.
quotaShare.wizardStep2Subtitle: Ƙayyade ma'aunan tsarin kaso (raka'a, tazarar lokaci, iyaka) don haɗin da aka zaɓa. Bar su ba tare da canji ba don riƙe saitunan yanzu.
quotaShare.wizardStep3Subtitle: Sanya API keys ga wannan tafki tare da rabe-raben nauyi (%) da iyakoki na zaɓi.
quotaShare.wizardDimensionsEditedNotice: An gyara ma'aunai — za a ajiye su a matsayin gyaran hannu lokacin da aka ƙirƙiri tafkin.
quotaShare.wizardExclusiveHint: Idan an kunna, waɗannan API keys za a ba su damar amfani da samfuran kama-da-wane na wannan tafki kawai (ana aiwatar da daidaitawar allowedQuotas lokacin ajiyewa).
quotaShare.wizardAdditionalConnectionsNote: Ƙarin haɗi suna amfani da tsoffin iyakokin kundinsu (ana iya gyarawa daga baya).
quotaShare.wizardSingleProviderNote: Tafki yana amfani da mai samarwa guda ɗaya
quotaShare.groupAllocationNote: Rabe-raben suna aiki ga duk tafkunan da ke wannan rukuni ta hanyar matakin kaso da aka raba.

quotaShare.betaText: Quota Share yana aiki amma ana sa ran samun kurakurai. Ka samu ɗaya? Da fatan za a kai rahoto.

omni-auth.name: Tabbatar da Shaida
omni-auth.description: Sarrafa tabbatar da shaida ta maɓallin API da token ɗin zama. Fara daga nan don tabbatar da sahihancin buƙatu ta hanyar Bearer token, samun kukis na zama, da saita buƙatun shiga don OmniRoute API.

omni-providers.name: Masu Bayar da Sabis
omni-providers.description: Sarrafa haɗin masu bayar da sabis, maɓallan API, hanyoyin OAuth, da gwaje-gwajen haɗi ta REST API. Jera, ƙara, sabunta, cire, da gwada haɗin masu bayar da AI (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, da fiye da 160).

omni-models.name: Samfura
omni-models.description: Nemo samfuran AI da ake da su a duk masu bayar da sabis da aka saita. Jera samfura, warware laƙabin samfura, da bincika cikakken kundin samfura ciki har da nau'ikan da suka keɓanta ga kowane mai bayarwa.

omni-combos-routing.name: Haɗe-haɗe da Juyar da Hanya
omni-combos-routing.description: Ƙirƙira da sarrafa haɗe-haɗen juyar da hanya tare da dabaru 14 (fifiko, mai nauyi, round-robin, Auto-combo, da sauransu). Saita jerin hanyoyin madadin, gwada sakamakon juyar da hanya, da ɗebo ma'aunin haɗe-haɗe.

omni-api-keys.name: Maɓallan API
omni-api-keys.description: Ƙirƙira, jera, sauya, da soke maɓallan OmniRoute API. Sarrafa izini, iyakokin kashe kuɗi, da wa'adin ƙarewa na kowane maɓalli. Maɓallan suna kayyade damar shiga duk wuraren ƙarshe na wakili da gudanarwa.

omni-usage-logs.name: Amfani da Rajistan Ayyuka
omni-usage-logs.description: Samun cikakkun rajistocin kira da nazarin amfani. Tace bisa mai bayarwa, samfuri, zangon lokaci, matsayi, da farashi. Fitar da rajistoci da tara yawan amfani da token a duk haɗe-haɗe.

omni-budget.name: Kasafin Kuɗi da Iyakokin Adadin Buƙatu
omni-budget.description: Saita iyakokin kashe kuɗi, kason token, da manufofin iyakance adadin buƙatu ga kowane maɓallin API ko a matakin gaba ɗaya. Duba amfanin yanzu da tilasta matakan kula da farashi a duk masu bayarwa.

omni-settings.name: Saituna
omni-settings.description: Karanta da sabunta saitunan manhaja na gaba ɗaya: umarnin tsarin, kasafin tunani, matatun IP, ƙa'idojin payload, tsoffin saitunan haɗe-haɗe, da saitin buƙatar shiga.

omni-proxies.name: Saitin Wakili
omni-proxies.description: Saita wakilan HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS don buƙatun da ake aikawa ga masu bayarwa. Ƙayyade ƙa'idojin wakili ga kowane mai bayarwa ko gaba ɗaya, gwada haɗuwa, da sarrafa jujjuyawar wakilai.

omni-cache.name: Ma'ajiyar Wucin Gadi
omni-cache.description: Sarrafa ma'ajiyar wucin gadi ta amsoshin LLM. Duba ƙididdigar ma'ajiyar, share bayanai, saita manufofin TTL, da sarrafa iyakokin adana bayanai bisa kamanceceniyar ma'ana.

omni-compression.name: Matsewa
omni-compression.description: Saita hanyoyin matsewa na RTK (sakamakon umarni), Caveman (rubutun zube), da na jere. Sarrafa fakitin harsuna da ƙa'idoji na musamman, sannan gwada matse prompt da ke rage token da 60–90%.

omni-context-rtk.name: Mahallin Bayanai da RTK
omni-context-rtk.description: Saita matatun RTK, ƙa'idojin tsara mahallin bayanai, da saitunan isar da mahallin. Gwada matsewa da ainihin samfurorin prompt, sannan sarrafa jerin ayyukan sauya mahallin bayanai.

omni-resilience.name: Juriya da Sa Ido
omni-resilience.description: Sa ido kan lafiyar masu bayarwa, yanayin circuit-breaker, ma'aunin jinkiri na p50/p95/p99, da faɗakarwar kariyar kasafin kuɗi. Duba lokutan dakatar da haɗi da hana samfura aiki a ainihin lokaci.

omni-cli-tools.name: Kayan Aikin CLI
omni-cli-tools.description: Sarrafa haɗin kayan aikin CLI da aka samar ta API. Jera, saita, da kira plugins na kayan aikin CLI waɗanda ke faɗaɗa damar sarrafa ayyuka ta atomatik na OmniRoute.

omni-tunnels.name: Ramukan Haɗi
omni-tunnels.description: Ƙirƙira da sarrafa amintattun ramukan haɗi (ngrok, Cloudflare Tunnel, custom) don buɗe OmniRoute ga intanet ko raba damar shiga tare da wakilai na nesa da bututun ayyukan CI.

omni-sync-cloud.name: Daidaitawa da Cloud
omni-sync-cloud.description: Daidaita tsarin daidaitawar OmniRoute, haɗin masu bayarwa, da saituna zuwa/daga ma'ajiyar cloud. Sarrafa tabbatar da shaidar ma'aikacin cloud da wuraren ajiyar bayanan madadin na nesa.

omni-db-backups.name: Ma'ajiyar Bayanai da Kwafin Madadin
omni-db-backups.description: Ƙaddamar da kwafin madadin na tsarin, maidowa daga fayilolin madadin, da sarrafa zagayowar rayuwar ma'ajiyar bayanan SQLite. Yana goyon bayan fitarwa, shigarwa, da dabarun hotunan bayanai masu ƙaruwa.

omni-webhooks.name: Ƙugiyoyin yanar gizo
omni-webhooks.description: Yi rajista, jera, gwada, da cire wuraren ƙarshen webhook. Saita rajistar abubuwan da suka faru (request.completed, request.failed, quota.exceeded, da sauransu), sannan sarrafa sake yunƙurin isarwa.

omni-mcp.name: Sabar MCP
omni-mcp.description: Haɗa zuwa sabar OmniRoute MCP (kayan aiki 110, hanyoyin sufuri 3: SSE/stdio/HTTP). Ya ƙunshi kayan aikin juyar da hanya, ma'ajiyar wucin gadi, matsewa, ƙwaƙwalwa, ƙwarewa, masu bayarwa, da kayan aikin bincike a cikin fannonin izini 33.

omni-agents-a2a.name: Wakilai da Ka'idar A2A
omni-agents-a2a.description: Mu'amala da OmniRoute ta hanyar ka'idar wakili-zuwa-wakili ta JSON-RPC 2.0. Ƙwarewar A2A guda 6 da aka gina a ciki: smart-routing, quota-management, provider-discovery, cost-analysis, health-report, list-capabilities.

omni-version-manager.name: Manajan Sigogi
omni-version-manager.description: Shigar, fara, dakatar, sake farawa, da sabunta ayyukan da aka haɗa a ciki (9Router, CLIProxyAPI). Sa ido kan matsayin ayyuka, samo rajistan ayyuka, da saita farawa ta atomatik don wuraren ƙarshen sabis na cikin gida kawai.

omni-inference.name: Inference (mai dacewa da OpenAI)
omni-inference.description: Muhimman ƙarshen inference masu dacewa da OpenAI: kammalawar taɗi, embeddings, hotuna, sauti (TTS/STT), moderations, rerank, da Responses API. Ita ce babbar hanyar haɗawa ga wakilan AI.

cli-serve.name: CLI: Bayar da Sabis
cli-serve.description: Fara, dakatar, da sake kunna sabar OmniRoute daga CLI. Sarrafa yanayin daemon, saitin port, farfaɗowa ta atomatik, haɗawa da system tray, da gajeriyar hanyar buɗe dashboard.

cli-health.name: CLI: Lafiya
cli-health.description: Duba lafiyar sabar, matsayin sassa, da ma'aunai kai tsaye daga CLI. Gudanar da `health`, `health components`, da `health watch` don dashboard na ainihin lokaci na circuit breakers da matsayin masu samarwa.

cli-providers.name: CLI: Masu Samarwa
cli-providers.description: Sarrafa haɗin masu samarwa daga CLI: jera masu samarwa da ake da su/waɗanda aka saita, ƙara, gwadawa, gwada-duka, tabbatarwa, sauya API keys, da duba ma'aunan kowane mai samarwa.

cli-keys.name: CLI: Maɓallan API
cli-keys.description: Ƙirƙira, jera, sauya, da soke OmniRoute API keys daga CLI. Sarrafa matakan OAuth don tantancewar masu samarwa, sannan duba fannonin izini da lokutan ƙarewar maɓallan.

cli-models.name: CLI: Samfura
cli-models.description: Nemi samfuran AI da ake da su, jera laƙaban samfura, da bincika cikakken kundin samfura daga CLI. Tace ta mai samarwa, bincika ta iyawa, da tantance bambance-bambancen sunan samfuri.

cli-chat.name: CLI: Taɗi
cli-chat.description: Aika kammalawar taɗi, watsa amsoshi kai tsaye, da fara zaman REPL mai hulɗa daga CLI. Yana goyon bayan duk masu samar da OmniRoute, combo routing, da saitin system prompt.

cli-routing.name: CLI: Routing da Combos
cli-routing.description: Ƙirƙira, jera, sabunta, da share routing combos daga CLI. Gwada dabarun routing, bincika ma'aunan combo, da saita fallback chains ta hanyar hulɗa.

cli-resilience.name: CLI: Juriya da Ƙa'idodin Amfani
cli-resilience.description: Bincika da sarrafa matsayin circuit-breaker, lokutan dakatar da haɗi, iyakokin quota, da matakan backoff daga CLI. Sake saita masu samarwa da suka maƙale, sannan saita ma'aunin juriya.

cli-compression.name: CLI: Matsewa
cli-compression.description: Saita da gwada matse prompt daga CLI. Sarrafa matatun RTK, ƙa'idojin Caveman, hanyoyin matsewa masu jeruwa, da samfotin sakamakon matsewa tare da prompts na ainihi.

cli-contexts.name: CLI: Mahallai da Zaman Tattaunawa
cli-contexts.description: Sarrafa saitunan context engineering, tarin matatun RTK, da zaman tattaunawa daga CLI. Aiwatar da saitunan context-relay, sannan bincika context pipelines masu aiki.

cli-cost-usage.name: CLI: Kuɗi da Amfani
cli-cost-usage.description: Duba rarrabuwar kuɗi, amfani da token, da rajistan kira daga CLI. Tace ta mai samarwa, samfuri, ko zangon kwanan wata. Fitar da rahotannin amfani, sannan bincika kashe kuɗin kowane haɗi.

cli-mcp.name: CLI: MCP
cli-mcp.description: Bincika matsayin sabar MCP, jera kayan aiki da iyakokin izini da aka yi wa rajista, gudanar da kiran kayan aiki, da sarrafa rajistan binciken MCP daga CLI.

cli-a2a.name: CLI: Ka'idar A2A
cli-a2a.description: Yi hulɗa da sabar OmniRoute A2A daga CLI. Aika ayyuka, bincika tarihin aiwatar da ƙwarewa, da gwada ka'idar sadarwar agent-to-agent ta JSON-RPC 2.0 ta hanyar hulɗa.

cli-tunnel.name: CLI: Ramuka
cli-tunnel.description: Fara da dakatar da haɗin tunnel (ngrok, Cloudflare, custom) daga CLI. Bincika URLs na tunnels masu aiki, saita tantancewa, da gwada yiwuwar isa daga waje.

cli-backup-sync.name: CLI: Ajiyar Bayanai da Daidaitawa
cli-backup-sync.description: Yi ajiyar bayanai da maido da bayanan OmniRoute daga CLI. Ƙaddamar da incremental snapshots, daidaita zuwa cloud storage, sarrafa jadawalin ajiyar bayanai, da maido daga archive files.

cli-policy-audit.name: CLI: Manufa da Binciken Ayyuka
cli-policy-audit.description: Bincika rajistan ayyuka, sarrafa manufofin samun dama, duba bayanan telemetry, da bitar tarihin buƙatu daga CLI. Tace ta nau'in aukuwa, mai amfani, ko zangon lokaci don ayyukan bin ƙa'ida.

cli-batches.name: CLI: Batches da Files
cli-batches.description: Mika batch inference jobs da sa ido a kansu daga CLI. Loda da sarrafa files don batch processing, samo sakamako, da haɗa batch pipelines da ayyukan CI/CD.

cli-eval.name: CLI: Kimantawa
cli-eval.description: Ƙirƙira da gudanar da rukunin gwaje-gwajen kimantawa, kalli ci gaban gwajin ma'auni kai tsaye, duba katunan sakamako, kwatanta aikin samfura, da haɗa gudanar da kimantawa da ayyukan CI daga CLI.

cli-plugins-skills.name: CLI: Furoginai, Ƙwarewa da Ƙwaƙwalwa
cli-plugins-skills.description: Sarrafa Omni Skills (jera, girka, gwada, cirewa), furoginai (ƙirƙira, daidaitawa), da ƙwaƙwalwa mai ɗorewa (bincika, ƙara, sharewa) daga CLI.

cli-setup.name: CLI: Saitawa da Kanfigareshan
cli-setup.description: Gudanar da saitin farko, daidaita saitunan CLI na gaba ɗaya, sarrafa masu canjin muhalli, bincika sabuntawa, da daidaita farawa ta atomatik ta amfani da umarnin setup da config na CLI.

cli-skill-collector.name: CLI: Mai Tattara Ƙwarewar Agent
cli-skill-collector.description: Gano kayan aikin rubuta lamba na CLI da aka girka (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Cline da sauransu), bincika GitHub don ƙwarewar agent da suka dace, sannan girka su a kayan aikin da aka gano ta amfani da APIs na cikin OmniRoute.

config-codex-cli.name: Kanfigareshan: Codex CLI
config-codex-cli.description: Tsarin aikin agent mataki-mataki don daidaita OpenAI Codex CLI a kowace na'ura (Linux, macOS, Windows) domin amfani da OmniRoute a matsayin backend mai dacewa da OpenAI. Yana gano OS da shell, yana rubuta config.toml da profiles 7 masu suna, yana saita masu canjin muhalli, sannan yana tabbatar da saitin.

omni-github-skills.name: Gano Ƙwarewa a GitHub
omni-github-skills.description: Bincika, ba da maki, tantance, da shigo da ƙwarewar agent daga ma'ajiyar GitHub da ke ɗauke da SKILL.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, da makamantan fayilolin ƙwarewar agent. Gano ƙwarewar al'umma a cikin nau'ikan masu samarwa sama da 160, kimanta dacewa ta hanyar ba da maki bisa ƙa'idojin hasashe, bincika malware ko sirrin da aka rubuta kai tsaye a cikin lamba, sannan girka su cikin kundin adireshin agent na Hermes, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, ko OpenCode.

agentSkills.pageSubtitle: Koyar da agent ɗinka yadda ake sarrafa OmniRoute — ɓangarorin API 23 + rukunin CLI 21

agent.title: Ƙwarewar Agent — Mai Fita
agent.description: Agent Skills takardun SKILL.md ne da na'ura za ta iya karantawa, waɗanda agents na AI na waje (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot…) ke ɗaukowa daga GitHub domin koyon yadda ake sarrafa OmniRoute ta REST ko CLI. Agent ne ke karanta su; OmniRoute ba ya aiwatar da su.

omni.title: Omni Skills — Mai Shigowa
omni.description: Omni Skills kayan aikin sandbox ne da OmniRoute ke sakawa cikin mahallin samfurin a kowace buƙata. OmniRoute ne ke aiwatar da su; agent ba ya karanta su.

freeProviderRankingsPage.subtitle: Mafi kyawun masu bayarwa kyauta da aka jera bisa makin ELO na samfura daga jadawalan jagoranci na Arena AI
freeProviderRankingsPage.emptyState: Har yanzu babu jerin matsayi. Bayanan Arena ELO suna daidaitawa lokacin farawa (kowace rana) — sake dubawa nan ba da jimawa ba, ko kuma fara daidaitawa da hannu. Kashe Arena ELO Sync a Feature Flags ko saita ARENA_ELO_SYNC_ENABLED=false don daina amfani da shi.

REQUIRE_API_KEY.description: Buƙaci maɓallin API ga duk buƙatun da ke shigowa.

INPUT_SANITIZER_ENABLED.description: Kunna tsaftace bayanan shigarwa ga duk buƙatu.

INJECTION_GUARD_MODE.description: Saita yanayin kariya daga allurar umarni.

PII_REDACTION_ENABLED.description: Ɓoye bayanan da za su iya bayyana ainihin mutum daga buƙatu.

PII_RESPONSE_SANITIZATION.description: Tsaftace bayanan da za su iya bayyana ainihin mutum a cikin martanin masu bayarwa.

PII_RESPONSE_SANITIZATION_MODE.description: Zaɓi yadda za a sarrafa PII na martani: redact yana maye gurbinsa, warn yana rubuta shi a rajista kawai, block yana ƙin karɓar martanin, kuma off yana kashe tsaftacewa.

OUTBOUND_SSRF_GUARD_ENABLED.description: Toshe buƙatun fita zuwa kewayon IP masu zaman kansu ko na cikin gida.

ALLOW_API_KEY_REVEAL.description: Ba masu amfani da dashboard da aka tantance damar bayyana maɓallan API da aka adana maimakon ganin ƙimomin da aka rufe kawai.

PROXY_AUTO_SELECT_ENABLED.description: Idan ba a sanya proxy ga haɗi ba, zaɓi proxy na registry na farko da ke aiki ta atomatik. A kashe yake ta tsohuwa domin idan ba haka ba, proxy ɗaya na registry zai zama madadin gama-gari ga duk zirga-zirga (#3332).

OMNIROUTE_CONTROL_PLANE_PROXY_DIRECT_FAL.description: Ba hanyoyin OAuth da na tabbatar da mai bayarwa damar ƙetare proxy da aka ɗaure idan gwajin isa ga proxy ya gaza. A kashe yake ta tsohuwa domin wannan na iya canza IP ɗin da asusun ke amfani da shi wajen fita.

MITM_DISABLE_TLS_VERIFY.description: Kashe tabbatar da takardar shaidar TLS ga MITM proxy.

OMNIROUTE_ALLOW_PRIVATE_PROVIDER_URLS.description: Ba da izinin URLs na masu bayarwa waɗanda ke nuni zuwa cibiyoyin sadarwa masu zaman kansu ko na cikin gida.

OMNIROUTE_ALLOW_LOCAL_PROVIDER_URLS.description: Ba da izinin masu bayarwa a localhost, LAN, da kewayon IP masu zaman kansu. Ana buƙatar wannan don samfurorin gida masu jituwa da OpenAI, kuma an kunna shi ta tsohuwa. Ana ci gaba da toshe endpoints na cloud-metadata kamar 169.254.169.254.

ENABLE_CC_COMPATIBLE_PROVIDER.description: Kunna yanayin mai bayarwa mai jituwa da Claude Code.

TOOL_POLICY_MODE.description: Saita yanayin tilasta manufofin amfani da kayan aiki.

RATE_LIMIT_AUTO_ENABLE.description: Kunna iyakance ƙimar amfani ta atomatik bisa tsarin amfani.

ALLOW_MULTI_CONNECTIONS_PER_COMPAT_NODE.description: Ba da izinin haɗe-haɗe da yawa ga kowane compatibility node.

DISABLE_CONTEXT_WINDOW_CHECKS.label: Kashe Binciken Context Window
DISABLE_CONTEXT_WINDOW_CHECKS.description: Tsallake binciken context-window da max-input-token na cikin gida na OmniRoute don buƙatun kai-tsaye na samfuri guda. Masu bayarwa na upstream har yanzu suna tilasta ainihin iyakokinsu. Matse prompt da iyakokin output-token suna ci gaba da aiki.

RESPONSES_PASSTHROUGH_DROP_COMMENTARY.description: Cire abubuwan fitarwa na matakin commentary na cikin gida daga rafukan passthrough na Responses API kafin a tura su ga abokan ciniki. Kashe wannan tutar don karɓar commentary na upstream ba tare da sarrafawa ba.

OMNIROUTE_MCP_ENFORCE_SCOPES.description: Tilasta ƙuntatawar scope don samun damar kayan aikin MCP.

OMNIROUTE_MCP_COMPRESS_DESCRIPTIONS.description: Matse bayanan kayan aikin MCP don rage amfani da token.

OMNIROUTE_ENABLE_RUNTIME_BACKGROUND_TASK.description: Kunna sarrafa ayyukan bango a lokacin runtime.

OMNIROUTE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_SERVICES.description: Kashe duk ayyukan bango, ciki har da sabunta quota da synchronization.

OMNIROUTE_RTK_TRUST_PROJECT_FILTERS.description: Amince da filters na RTK na matakin project ba tare da validation ba.

OMNIROUTE_ENABLE_LIVE_WS.description: Fara uwar garken WebSocket na dashboard na ainihin lokaci yayin import a loopback port 20132. Saita tutar zuwa 0 ko false don kashe shi. Bayyanawa ga LAN kuma yana buƙatar LIVE_WS_HOST=0.0.0.0 da LIVE_WS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.

OMNIROUTE_CODEX_WS_ENABLED.description: Ba Codex damar amfani da Responses ta WebSocket. Idan an kashe, Codex zai koma amfani da HTTP Responses.

OMNIROUTE_EMERGENCY_FALLBACK.description: Tura buƙatun da kasafinsu ya ƙare zuwa mai bayarwa da samfurin madadin gaggawa na kyauta.

STREAM_RECOVERY_ENABLED.description: Sake gwada rafukan SSE na upstream da suka yanke ba tare da abokin ciniki ya lura ba kafin wani byte na martani ya isa gare shi.

STREAM_RECOVERY_MIDSTREAM_ENABLED.description: Ba stream recovery damar sake neman martanin sannan ya haɗa shi bayan bytes sun riga sun isa ga abokin ciniki.

STREAM_RECOVERY_TOOLCALL_ORDER_FIX.description: Tabbatar da ci gaba a tsakiyar kwarara bayan kiran kayan aiki yana da aminci: kada a taɓa ci gaba da kwararar da aka katse bayan an aika kiran kayan aiki (ko har yanzu yana gudana ko ya riga ya ƙare), sannan a dakata bayan ci gaba mara komai guda ɗaya maimakon amfani da duk kasafin sake gwadawa.

STREAM_EARLY_EOF_SIBLING_FAILOVER_ENABLE.description: Canja sau ɗaya zuwa wani haɗin na rukuni ɗaya idan rafi ya rufe kafin ya fitar da kowane firam mai amfani, kuma an ƙare iyakantaccen sake gwadawa na wannan haɗin. Idan babu wani haɗin da za a iya amfani da shi, za a mayar da kuskuren early-EOF na asali. A kashe: early-EOF zai kasance na ƙarshe bayan sake gwadawar.

MODEL_CATALOG_INCLUDE_NAMES.description: Haɗa filayen suna masu sauƙin nunawa a cikin martanin /v1/models. Kashe wannan ga abokan cinikin da ke karɓar IDs na samfuri kawai.

MODELS_CATALOG_PREFIX_MODE.description: Sarrafa prefixes na model-ID a cikin /v1/models: dual yana fitar da prefixes na alias da canonical, alias yana fitar da gajerun prefixes kawai, kuma canonical yana fitar da cikakkun IDs na masu bayarwa kawai.

ARENA_ELO_SYNC_ENABLED.description: Daidaita bayanan ELO na leaderboard na Arena AI lokaci-lokaci don martabar model-intelligence.

CLI_COMPAT_ALL.description: Kunna yanayin jituwa ga duk abokan cinikin CLI.

PRICING_SYNC_ENABLED.description: Daidaita bayanan farashi ta atomatik. Dole ne ma canjin mahalli na PRICING_SYNC_ENABLED ya kasance true.

OMNIROUTE_AUTO_SYNC_CODEX_PROFILES.description: Bayan daidaita mai bayarwa da samfurin, sake ƙirƙirar bayanan martaba na ~/.codex/*.config.toml daga kundin da ke aiki. Wannan ba ya taɓa canza saitin Codex mai aiki ko na asali, kuma a kashe yake ta tsohuwa.

OMNIROUTE_AUTO_SYNC_CLAUDE_PROFILES.description: Bayan daidaita mai bayarwa da samfurin, sake ƙirƙirar bayanan martaba na ~/.claude/profiles/'<name>'/settings.json daga kundin da ke aiki. Wannan ba ya taɓa canza saitin Claude mai aiki ko na asali, kuma a kashe yake ta tsohuwa.

OMNIROUTE_DISABLE_LOCAL_HEALTHCHECK.description: Kashe endpoint ɗin duba lafiyar instance na cikin gida.

OMNIROUTE_DISABLE_TOKEN_HEALTHCHECK.description: Kashe duba lafiyar tabbatar da token.

SKILLS_SANDBOX_NETWORK_ENABLED.description: Kunna damar shiga cibiyar sadarwa a cikin akwatin gwajin skills.

SERVER_OWNED_TOOL_LOOP_ENABLED.label: Madaukin Kayan Aiki Mallakar Sabar
SERVER_OWNED_TOOL_LOOP_ENABLED.description: Ci gaba da kiran kayan aiki mallakar sabar waɗanda ba na streaming ba har sai samfurin ya dawo da martanin da abokin ciniki zai iya amfani da shi.

RETRY_AFTER_PROVENANCE_ENABLED.label: Asalin Retry-After
RETRY_AFTER_PROVENANCE_ENABLED.description: A kan haɗaɗɗun martanin rashin samuwa na 429/503, a cire Retry-After idan ba a san takamaiman lokacin sake gwadawa na gaba ba maimakon aika ƙirƙirarren 1s, a ƙara error.retry_after_provenance, sannan a karanta alamomin sake gwadawa na rubutu a hanyoyin zubar da combo.

PROTECTED_PRIORITY_INFRA_502_ENABLED.label: Tsayawar Infra na Protected-Priority a matsayin 502
PROTECTED_PRIORITY_INFRA_502_ENABLED.description: A ba da amsar 502 maimakon 503 lokacin da maƙasudin fifiko na quota-only-fallback ya dakatar da combo saboda dalilin da aka tabbatar ba quota ba ne: buɗaɗɗen circuit breaker na provider ko tsallakewa bisa hasashen latency.

radarPage.title: Kasidar Radar
radarPage.subtitle: Kasidar samfura ta kyauta da aka inganta da bayanan al'umma
radarPage.emptyState: Babu bayanan kasida tukuna. Yi aiki tare don sauke sabon feed.
radarPage.activateDescription: Kwatanta damar Al'umma da damar kai tsaye, fahimci abin da shigarwarka ke musayarwa, sannan ka zaɓi yadda za ka kunna Radar.
radarPage.accessScaleIntro: Radar ba zai yi amfani da hanyar sadarwa ba har sai ka amince. Zaɓi damar Al'umma ko kunna maɓallin mai tallafawa na kanka bayan ka duba waɗannan ƙa'idoji.
radarPage.accessCommunityRule: Al'umma — ba a buƙatar maɓalli: cikakkiyar kasida mai jinkirin kwanaki 30.
radarPage.accessSingleUseRule: Sanya tauraro + bi — bayan GitHub OAuth ya tabbatar da duka biyun, asusun GitHub ɗinka zai samu damar karanta kasidar kai tsaye sau ɗaya; daga nan damar za ta koma ta Al'umma. Ba za a iya sake ba wannan asusun damar ta lokaci ɗaya ba.
radarPage.accessContributorRule: Masu ba da gudummawa — PRs da aka haɗe, commits, da layukan lamba ne kawai ke tsara jeri na mako-mako. Goma na farko za su samu kwanaki 365; masu matsayi na 11–100 za su samu kwanaki 90; masu ba da gudummawa da ba su cikin 100 na farko ba za su samu kyauta ba, komai yawan PR ɗinsu. Fita daga jerin ba zai taɓa rage lokacin da aka riga aka bayar ba.
radarPage.accessSupporterRule: Masu tallafawa — sayayya ta lokaci ɗaya tana ba da watanni 6, shekara 1, ko damar dindindin ba tare da sabuntawa ta atomatik ba. Sayayya, gudummawar kuɗi, lokutan masu ba da gudummawa, da kyaututtukan da aka bayar da hannu suna taruwa; damar dindindin ce koyaushe ke rinjaye.
radarPage.accessUseTitle: Amfani na kashin kai, dawo da dama, da dubawa
radarPage.accessInstallationRule: Lasisi na kashin kai — yi amfani da maɓallin a kan shigarwa guda ɗaya mai aiki a lokaci guda. OmniRoute ba ya ɗaukar sawun kayan aiki. Dawo da dama yana soke maɓallin da ya ɓace ya kuma maye gurbinsa ba tare da sake saita ranar ƙarewarsa ba.
radarPage.accessAbuseRule: Binciken cin zarafi — adireshin IP daban na huɗu cikin sa'o'i 24 yana haifar da alamar dubawa ta hannu kawai; ba ya taɓa toshewa ko soke maɓalli ta atomatik.
radarPage.accessOffersRule: Ana zaɓar tayin kai-tsaye da hannu, kuma suna iya canzawa ko ƙarewa.
radarPage.privacyDownloadsRule: Abubuwan da ake saukewa — shigarwarka tana karɓar kasida da metadata na turawa da aka sanya wa hannu ta hanyar cryptography; ingantaccen maɓallin kai-tsaye kuma yana buɗe tayin da aka sanya wa hannu da Intel.
radarPage.privacySendsRule: Abubuwan da ake aikawa — daidaitawar gefen uwar garke tana aika maɓallin mai tallafawa a matsayin Bearer token, sannan tsarin HTTPS yana karɓar IP na haɗin. Lissafin buƙatun feed ba ya adana ko ɗaya daga cikin ƙimomin a ɗanyen tsari: yana adana hashes na maɓalli, jimillar amfani, da gajartaccen IP HMAC mai sauyawa kullum don nazarin cin zarafi.
radarPage.privacyNeverRule: Abubuwan da ba a taɓa tattarawa ba — umarnin shigarwa, amsoshi, tattaunawa, bayanan shiga na masu samarwa, zirga-zirgar samfura, lokacin aiki, jinkiri, da saitunan masu samarwa na gida ba a taɓa aikawa zuwa Radar.

radarPage.contributorHint: GitHub OAuth yana duba matsayin mako na yanzu: Manyan 10 suna samun kwanaki 365, yayin da masu matsayi na 11–100 suke samun kwanaki 90. Yawan PR shi kaɗai ba ya taɓa ba da damar shiga ga waɗanda ba sa cikin Manyan 100.
radarPage.supporterHint: Zaɓuɓɓukan watanni 6, shekara 1, da na har abada da ake biya sau ɗaya ba su da sabuntawa ta atomatik; lokutan da suka cancanta suna taruwa, kuma zaɓin na har abada yana rinjayar sauran.

401.title: Ba a Ba da Izini ba
401.description: Ana buƙatar tantancewa don samun damar wannan albarkatun.

403.description: An fahimci buƙatarka, amma manufofi sun hana samun dama.

403.suggestion2: Tabbatar da manufofin samfuri da kasafin kuɗi da aka sanya wa maɓallin API ɗinka.

429.suggestion1: Jira lokacin hutu ya ƙare, sannan sake gwadawa bayan tazarar da aka ba da shawara.
429.suggestion2: Canja zuwa combo mai madadin masu samarwa.
429.suggestion3: Daidaita bayanan martabar juriyar mai samarwa/iyakokin ƙimar buƙatu a cikin saituna.

500.title: Kuskuren Cikin Sabar
500.description: An samu kuskuren da ba a yi tsammani ba a ɓangaren sabar yayin sarrafa buƙatarka.
500.suggestion1: Sake gwadawa sau ɗaya bayan ƴan daƙiƙu.
500.suggestion2: Duba bayanan telemetry na lafiyar tsarin da rajistan ayyukan sabar don ID na buƙatu masu alaƙa.
500.suggestion3: Idan matsalar ta ci gaba, kai rahotonta tare da tambarin lokaci da mahallin buƙatar.
500.primaryAction: Buɗe Allon Kula da Lafiyar Tsarin

502.title: Kuskuren Ƙofar Sadarwa
502.description: Mai samarwa na upstream ko haɗin gateway ya dawo da amsa mara inganci.
502.suggestion1: Sake gwadawa da wani mai samarwa ko hanyar combo mai aiki.
502.suggestion2: Duba bayanan shaidar mai samarwa da samuwar samfuri.
502.suggestion3: Bincika sakamakon translator idan ana sauya tsari.

503.title: Sabis Ba Ya Samuwa
503.description: Sabis ɗin ba ya samuwa na ɗan lokaci saboda gyare-gyare ko matsala a abubuwan da yake dogaro da su.
503.suggestion1: Jira ɗan lokaci sannan ka sake gwadawa.
503.suggestion2: Duba sanarwar gyare-gyare da matsayin tsarin.
503.suggestion3: Yi amfani da madadin masu samarwa idan aikinka yana buƙatar ƙarancin jinkiri.
